pageInfo.subtitle: Master alternate picking, economy picking, and hybrid techniques for clean and expressive playing.
pageInfo.heroDescription: Develop precision, speed, and control with your picking hand through these essential exercises. Each pattern focuses on different aspects of picking technique, from strict alternate picking to advanced hybrid and economy picking methods.

items.text: Keep picking motion small and efficient
Focus on clean attack and consistent timing
Maintain relaxed grip and wrist position
Use a metronome for consistent tempo
Practice each pattern slowly before increasing speed
Focus on accuracy over speed initially

exercises.title: Alternate Picking Foundation
exercises.description: Practice strict down-up picking on a single string. Every note should alternate between downstroke and upstroke. Keep the picking motion small and close to the strings.

notation.title: Alternate Picking Foundation Exercise
notation.staveTitle: Strict Down-Up Alternate Picking on Single String

practiceNotes.title: Practice Notes
practiceNotes.text: Practice strict down-up picking on a single string. Every note should alternate between downstroke and upstroke. Keep the picking motion small and close to the strings. Focus on evenness and clean articulation of each note.

exercises.title: String Crossing Alternate Picking
exercises.description: Maintain strict alternate picking while crossing strings. This is crucial for developing coordination between both hands. Keep the picking pattern consistent regardless of string changes.

practiceNotes.title: Practice Notes
practiceNotes.text: Maintain strict alternate picking while crossing strings. This is crucial for developing coordination between both hands. Keep the picking pattern consistent regardless of string changes.

exercises.title: Economy Picking Pattern
exercises.description: Use downstrokes when moving to lower (thicker) strings and upstrokes when moving to higher (thinner) strings. This sweeping motion is more efficient for certain passages and scales.

notation.title: Economy Picking Pattern Exercise
notation.staveTitle: Economy Picking - Sweep Motion on String Changes

practiceNotes.title: Practice Notes
practiceNotes.text: Use downstrokes when moving to lower (thicker) strings and upstrokes when moving to higher (thinner) strings. This "sweeping" motion is more efficient for certain passages and scales.

exercises.title: Hybrid Picking Pattern
exercises.description: Use the pick for bass notes (low E string) and your middle or ring finger for higher strings. This technique allows for rapid arpeggios and complex chord-melody playing.

practiceNotes.title: Practice Notes
practiceNotes.text: Use the pick for bass notes (low E string) and your middle or ring finger for higher strings. This technique allows for rapid arpeggios and complex chord-melody playing.

exercises.title: Tremolo Picking Exercise
exercises.description: Practice rapid alternate picking on a single note. Start slowly and gradually increase speed while maintaining evenness. This technique is essential for metal and classical guitar styles.

notation.title: Tremolo Picking Exercise
notation.staveTitle: Rapid Alternate Picking on Single Note

practiceNotes.title: Practice Notes
practiceNotes.text: Practice rapid alternate picking on a single note. Start slowly and gradually increase speed while maintaining evenness. This technique is essential for metal and classical guitar styles.

exercises.title: Chromatic Picking Coordination
exercises.description: Combine chromatic fretting patterns with strict alternate picking. This exercise develops coordination between both hands and is excellent for building speed and accuracy.

notation.title: Chromatic Picking Coordination Exercise
notation.staveTitle: Chromatic Pattern with Strict Alternate Picking

practiceNotes.title: Practice Notes
practiceNotes.text: Combine chromatic fretting patterns with strict alternate picking. This exercise develops coordination between both hands and is excellent for building speed and accuracy.

items.title: Technical Focus
items: Keep picking motion small and efficient
Maintain relaxed grip on the pick
Focus on consistent attack and tone
Practice with a metronome for steady timing

items.title: Why Picking Matters
items: Consistent picking technique is the foundation for clean, fast, and expressive playing
Whether playing rhythm guitar, lead lines, or fingerstyle arrangements, proper picking technique improves your tone, speed, and musical expression
Regular practice builds the muscle memory essential for advanced techniques
